title: Count to 10 for Kids! Numbers 6 to 10 with Bloop
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Bloop, and welcome to Bloop's Color Lab!
Today we're counting all the way up to ten!
I put on my lab goggles, and I'm ready to learn something new with you.
Can you count with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Ready? Let's wiggle into the lab!

lines: Here's a clue: it comes right after five! Can you guess?
This is the number six! Can you say six?
Let's count the apples. One, two, three, four, five, six!
Six shiny red apples, sitting in two neat rows.
Can you hold up six fingers? Five on one hand, and one more!
Can you guess? How many dots are in my counting frame?
Six! Five dots on top, and one more on the bottom.
One more time, nice and loud: SIX! Great job!
Six is one more than five. Five, and one more, makes six!
Here's a clue: it comes right after six! Can you guess?
This is the number seven! Can you say seven?
Let's count the ducks. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven!
Seven little yellow ducks. Quack, quack, quack!
Can you waddle like a little duck? Waddle, waddle, quack!
Can you guess? How many dots are in my counting frame now?
Seven! Five dots on top, and two more on the bottom.
One more time, nice and loud: SEVEN! Great job!
There are seven days in one week. Seven is one more than six!
Here's a clue: it comes right after seven! Can you guess?
This is the number eight! Can you say eight?
Let's count the fish. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight!
Eight happy blue fish, swimming along together.
Can you swim with your hands like a little fish? Swish, swish!
Can you guess? How many dots are in my counting frame?
Eight! Five dots on top, and three more on the bottom.
One more time, nice and loud: EIGHT! Great job!
An octopus has eight arms. Eight is one more than seven!
Here's a clue: it comes right after eight! Can you guess?
This is the number nine! Can you say nine?
Let's count the strawberries. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine!
Nine juicy red strawberries, with tiny yellow seeds.
Can you jump nine times? Ready? Jump, jump, jump, jump, jump, jump, jump, jump, jump!
Can you guess? How many boxes are empty in my counting frame?
Just one! Nine boxes are full, and only one is empty.
One more time, nice and loud: NINE! Great job!
Nine is one more than eight. We're almost at ten!
Here's a clue: it comes right after nine! Can you guess?
This is the number ten! Can you say ten?
Let's count my jelly friends. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten!
Ten jelly friends, in all the colors of the rainbow!
Can you wiggle all ten of your fingers? Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle!
Can you guess? How full is my counting frame now?
All full! Five dots on top, and five on the bottom.
One more time, nice and loud: TEN! Great job!
Ten fingers and ten toes. Ten is one more than nine!

outro: Can you count to ten all by yourself? Try it with your fingers at home.
Bye, friends! See you in the lab!
